reasons.eligible: All recorded acquisition criteria have been met.
reasons.notEligible: The case does not meet the acquisition criteria.
reasons.exceptionApproved: The exception review has been approved.
reasons.koFailed: At least one knock-out criterion has not been met.

placeholders.exceptionReason: Why should the case proceed despite amber criteria?

region.label: Region According to the Postbank Housing Atlas
region.requirement: Green regions are permitted, amber regions require exception review, and orange/red regions are excluded.

market_value.requirement: At least €250,000 and no more than €1,000,000.
market_value.missingPreliminary: Please enter a preliminary market value first.
market_value.missingAppraisal: Please enter the appraised market value first.
market_value.appraisalBelow: The appraised market value is below €250,000.
market_value.appraisalAbove: The appraised market value is above €1,000,000.
market_value.within: The market value is within the acquisition range.

land_value.label: Standard Land Value
land_value.failed: The standard land value is no more than €100/m².

property_type.label: Property Type
property_type.requirement: Residential buildings with up to 2 units, detached, semi-detached or terraced houses, or owner-occupied flats with management.
property_type.managementMissing: An owner-occupied flat without property or owners’ association management is excluded.
property_type.managementUnknown: Management must be confirmed for owner-occupied flats.

remaining_useful_life.label: Remaining Useful Life
remaining_useful_life.requirement: More than 35 years; exception review is possible where development potential exists.
remaining_useful_life.exception: Short remaining useful life with development potential: exception approval required.
remaining_useful_life.failed: The remaining useful life is no more than 35 years.

energy_class.label: Energy Efficiency Class
energy_class.requirement: Classes A to F are permitted; G/H require a refurbishment/modernisation plan or exception review.
energy_class.exception: Energy class G/H: a refurbishment plan or exception approval is required.

living_area.label: Living Area per Unit
living_area.requirement: Less than 225 m² per residential unit.
living_area.exception: Living area of 225 m² or more: internal exception review required.

monument_protection.label: Listed Building Status
monument_protection.requirement: The property must not be listed.
monument_protection.failed: Listed building status is a hard knock-out criterion.

leasehold.label: Heritable Building Right
leasehold.failed: A heritable building right is a hard knock-out criterion.

rating_threshold.label: Internal Rating Threshold
rating_threshold.requirement: Rating of at least 2.5 out of 6.0.
rating_threshold.pending: This criterion will be assessed finally once the rating has been calculated.
rating_threshold.failed: The rating is below the internal acquisition threshold.

messages.saveFailed: The Pre-Check could not be saved.
